items.title: United Parcel Service (UPS) Appoints Shannon Eisenhardt To Its Board And Audit Committee
items.summary: United Parcel Service (NYSE:UPS) appointed Shannon Eisenhardt to its Board of Directors, effective immediately, and named her to the Audit Committee. Eisenhardt brings executive finance experience from prior senior roles at Reckitt Benckiser and Nike, with a focus on global consumer businesses. Her background spans corporate finance, business planning, and technology leadership, which may affect how UPS evaluates future projects and controls.
